messages:
natalie: opened a focused PR to update several model-cards and the catalog migration notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534
natalie: goals: swap legacy curl examples for SDK v3 patterns, add a concise Dedicated runbook, correct embed-shard math, and pin benchmark rows to runner commit 2026-04-rc2
lee: nice. please include one short line at the top that customers can drop into release notes
natalie: added: "Catalog changes: clarifies supported variants, updates long-context limits, and documents edge-quant eviction behavior."
kevin: for the edge-quant note ops wants a single-sentence forensic summary they can paste into support replies
natalie: added: "edge-quant can evict older KV buckets at different bucket boundaries than classic quant; apps needing stable KV retention should pin a compat/legacy variant."
sam: embed-shard math was off in the original. use ceil(total_tokens / shard_size). also remind users tokenizer counts vary by model and show using the /tokenize endpoint first
natalie: corrected the math and added two snippets (python + ts). python snippet:

```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
texts = ["long doc...", "another doc..."]
# tokenize via API to get model-specific counts
counts = [c.tokenize(t) for t in texts]  # pseudocode
shard_size = 1500
num_shards = (sum(counts) + shard_size - 1) // shard_size  # ceil division
```

natalie: TypeScript streaming example for SDK v3 (channel style) too:

```ts
import Redwood from "@redwood/inference"
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
for await (const chunk of client.chat.stream({ model: "polarion4b", messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Summarize..." }] })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.delta ?? "")
}
```

olga: support requested a 3-step Dedicated runbook with explicit actions and who to contact. kept it minimal and actionable please
natalie: added "Dedicated quick runbook":
1) Pin your current model version in Console before changing catalog references.
2) Mirror 1% of production traffic to a test pool and validate latency/throughput.
3) If metrics change, open a support ticket to resize reserved capacity and request SLA review.

kevin: small doc nit: define max_seq vs effective_seq. customers keep tripping over that distinction
natalie: added a short line: "effective_seq = max_seq - reserved_prefix_tokens (e.g., system prompts)" plus a tiny ascii table for clarity
sam: docs-bot linkcheck flagged a broken benchmark link earlier; please pin to the runner commit and update the CSV path
olga: fixed the external link to /benchmarks/polarion/2026-04-rc2.csv and added the runner commit in the table caption
docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 external 404 fixed, 1 unresolved anchor (runtime-router anchor). Re-run scheduled on merge
kevin: please standardize on the word "variant" (not "profile") across all updated cards
natalie: standardized wording, squashed fixups. I'll merge once docs-bot is green and QA confirms the SDK snippets compile locally. thanks all :sparkles:
